comment: AI 614 inspection rig, shared by the Blender rig (import_baseline.py) and the game capture (tests/headless/visual/specs/terramar_recessed_blender_export_capture.pwtest.js). Blender config frame: metres, z up, front run A faces -Y, street z 0. vfov_deg is the vertical field of view (three.js fov; Blender sensor_fit VERTICAL). Plain look-at cameras, no lens shift, so the game and Blender frames are identical; matching the reference photos' own perspective (parallel verticals, exact stand) is a later calibration step.

lighting.comment: The game's own defaults since 2026-09-10 (src/graphics/lighting/CalibratedDaylight.js, CALIBRATED_DAYLIGHT): the game capture passes no lighting overrides, and the Blender rig mirrors them. The calibrated sky is disc-free (generated in Blender 5.2.1, see its .json sidecar); the sun is one directional light. Sun direction in the three.js convention dir = (cos az cos el, sin el, sin az cos el).
